operator: Council on Compulsive Gambling of New Jersey
counting_rule: Calls to 1-800-GAMBLER the Council reports it responded to in its fiscal year (July 1 to June 30). Whether repeat callers, texts and chats, or callers from outside New Jersey to the national number are included is not stated.
